question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Jane Eyre, Bob gets Ivanhoe, Claire gets Emma, Dave gets The Trial, Eve gets Dune, Fred gets Candide, and Gertrude gets The Hobbit.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Claire and Fred swap books. Then, Claire and Bob swap books. Then, Eve and Alice swap books. Then, Eve and Bob swap books. Then, Claire and Bob swap books. Then, Eve and Gertrude swap books. Finally, Claire and Bob swap books. At the end of the semester, Fred has
Options:
(A) Jane Eyre
(B) Ivanhoe
(C) Emma
(D) The Trial
(E) Dune
(F) Candide
(G) The Hobbit
solution:
Each row lists the books held by Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude, in that order.
Initial: Jane Eyre | Ivanhoe | Emma | The Trial | Dune | Candide | The Hobbit
1. Claire–Fred: Jane Eyre | Ivanhoe | Candide | The Trial | Dune | Emma | The Hobbit
2. Claire–Bob: Jane Eyre | Candide | Ivanhoe | The Trial | Dune | Emma | The Hobbit
3. Eve–Alice: Dune | Candide | Ivanhoe | The Trial | Jane Eyre | Emma | The Hobbit
4. Eve–Bob: Dune | Jane Eyre | Ivanhoe | The Trial | Candide | Emma | The Hobbit
5. Claire–Bob: Dune | Ivanhoe | Jane Eyre | The Trial | Candide | Emma | The Hobbit
6. Eve–Gertrude: Dune | Ivanhoe | Jane Eyre | The Trial | The Hobbit | Emma | Candide
7. Claire–Bob: Dune | Jane Eyre | Ivanhoe | The Trial | The Hobbit | Emma | Candide
Fred has Emma, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
